description: Needs enableSupervisedControl and an integrated or dedicated server. Replace one block at an exact position, only if the block there is `expect` right now. Block state is allowed (oak_stairs[facing=north]), block data ({...}) is not. Answers with outcome applied (read back), not_applied (precondition failed, nothing changed) or uncertain (call supervised_reconcile, which reads the block again; the change is never retried automatically).

dimension.description: Dimension id, e.g. "minecraft:overworld", "minecraft:the_nether". Defaults to the current/overworld dimension.

expect.description: The block id that must be there now, e.g. "minecraft:air".

name: supervised_set_block
title: Supervised block change
